A free, open-source file converter you use by dragging.
Hold a key (Ctrl, Option on macOS), drag files and drop them on a format in the donut that opens at your cursor.

Website · Download · LinkedIn · Install · Command line · Development

English · Español · 日本語 · 한국어 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Polski · हिन्दी · Русский · العربية · فارسی · Português (Brasil) · Português (Portugal) · Français · ไทย · Türkçe · Bahasa Indonesia · Italiano · বাংলা

Right at your cursor
No app window to open. The formats appear where you already are, only the ones that make sense for the files you drag. 		270 formats, no other software
Images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD, 3D models and geospatial data work without Office, Hancom Office or LibreOffice. 		Stays on your computer
Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline and saves the result next to the original.
## See it in action


Watch the 27-second video and try the interactive demo on filee.sh

## Install Download from [Releases](https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Filee/releases/latest). Or with WinGet: ```powershell winget install KnifeLemon.Filee ``` - **Windows 10/11**: run `Filee--win-Setup.exe`, or unzip the `win-Portable.zip` and run `Filee.exe`. - Setup is Filee's own installer, in Filee's languages, and needs nothing else on the PC. - It can add the Explorer menu, start at sign-in, the `filee` command and optional engines. - Silent installs take Inno Setup's switches (`/VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES`). - **macOS 13+** (preview): unpack the `osx-arm64` or `osx-x64` package and run `./install.sh`. - Or open the `.dmg` and drag Filee to Applications (the `filee` command comes with `install.sh`). - The build isn't notarized yet, so allow the first start in System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. - **Linux x64/ARM64** (Ubuntu 22.04+): unpack the package and run `./install.sh` (no root, needs Python 3). - Drag gestures need X11. On Wayland, use the drop zone and the file manager's right-click menu. Filee shows new releases in its menu and updates itself, keeping your settings and engines. After an update, a few slides show what's new. **Windows: Filee doesn't start (no window, no error)?** This happens on Windows 10 that hasn't been updated for a long time, on a PC whose processor supports Hardware-enforced Stack Protection (CET). Windows turns that protection on but lacks a part that .NET needs, so Filee and Setup stop right away. - **Recommended:** install the available Windows updates (the latest cumulative update). - **If updating isn't possible:** turning the protection off for Filee alone usually works. Run this in PowerShell as administrator: ```powershell Set-ProcessMitigation -Name Filee.exe -Disable UserShadowStack Set-ProcessMitigation -Name filee-cli.exe -Disable UserShadowStack ``` Do the same with Setup's file name (e.g. `Filee--win-Setup.exe`), or use the portable ZIP, which needs only these two lines. To undo it, remove the entries in Windows Security → App & browser control → Exploit protection settings → Program settings. ## Features - **A donut at the cursor**: hold a key, drag files and drop them on a format. Only formats that fit the files appear. - **Straight from the browser**: drag a picture, a link to a file or a download out of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari the same way. - Filee saves it to your Downloads folder (or keeps only the converted file) and converts it. - Links are downloaded without your browser's sign-in. - **One toolbar per file type**, arranged by drag and drop, with presets for: - quality, size, DPI - PDF pages and compression - video and audio - output folder and file names - **Two sides to every donut**: press Tab or turn the mouse wheel while it is open to flip it over to less common formats and tools. - **Crop before converting**: the Crop slice opens pictures one by one. Drag the frame, pick a ratio, and only that part is saved. - **Many files at once**, in parallel. Routes with several steps (HWP → HWPX → DOCX) are found automatically. - **Watch folders** convert every file that lands in them. - **Recent conversions** on Home, each with a thumbnail: open the result, or open it with another app. - **A file list on Home**: turn on *Collect dropped files in a list* in General settings, and files dropped on Home (including those dragged from a browser) wait in a list instead of opening the donut. Drag the cards or use Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ to set the order, Delete to remove one, and *Choose action* to open the donut for the list in that order. The list empties when that conversion completes. - **Other ways in**: the right-click menu, a keyboard shortcut, the drop zone and the [`filee` command](#command-line). - Light and dark themes with your own accent colour and donut opacity, in English, Español, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Polski, हिन्दी, Русский, العربية (right to left), Português (Brasil), Français, नेपाली, ไทย, Türkçe, Português (Portugal), Deutsch, Italiano, Bahasa Indonesia and Tiếng Việt. ## Screenshots

Marked ones need an optional engine, downloaded only when needed: ¹ Ghostscript, ² LibreOffice, ³ Pandoc, ⁴ calibre, ⁵ FFmpeg ([details](docs/ENGINES.md)). ## Command line The `filee` command uses the same engines and presets as the app (Setup or `install.sh` adds it). ``` filee convert photo.heic --to jpg filee convert *.png --to webp --quality 80 -o converted filee watch D:\Inbox --to pdf --move-originals ``` Every command and option: [filee.sh/cli](https://filee.sh/cli/) or `filee help`. ## Development Build with the .NET 10 SDK on Windows, macOS or Linux: ```bash git clone https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Filee.git cd Filee pwsh build/fetch-engines.ps1 -Only rhwp,pandoc # optional engines dotnet run --project src/Filee.App dotnet test ``` [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Engines](docs/ENGINES.md) · [Adding a converter](docs/ADDING-A-CONVERTER.md) · [Adding a language](docs/ADDING-A-LANGUAGE.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) Pull requests are welcome. If Filee saves you some clicks, a ⭐ helps other people find it. ## Code signing policy Filee is developed and published by **Myeonggu Kim** ([KnifeLemon](https://github.com/KnifeLemon)). - Windows releases are signed with a [Certum](https://www.certum.eu/) open source code signing certificate issued to Myeonggu Kim ("Open Source Developer MYEONGGU KIM"). - Releases before it, up to 2.0.0, are not signed. - SmartScreen can still warn about a new release until it has been downloaded enough ("More info" → "Run anyway"). - macOS packages are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. - Only files built by this repository's GitHub Actions release workflow are signed, and every release is signed and approved by hand. - Libraries and programs their makers signed (.NET, SkiaSharp, ImageMagick, the Microsoft C++ runtime …) keep their own signatures; bundled ones that come unsigned (rhwp, 7-Zip and most libraries) are signed with Filee's certificate, as part of Filee. ### Privacy policy Filee converts files on your own computer and never uploads them. It collects no usage data and sends no telemetry. It connects to the internet only: - to ask GitHub (`api.github.com`) whether a newer release exists, shortly after start and then every few hours. Turn this off in Settings → About ("Check for updates automatically"). - to download the conversion engines you choose to install, from the official locations pinned in [`engines.json`](src/Filee.Engines/Infrastructure/engines.json), and the text recognition (OCR) languages a preset uses, pinned in [`ocr-languages.json`](src/Filee.Engines/Infrastructure/ocr-languages.json). - when you click a link, which opens your web browser. ## Sponsor Filee is free and stays free. If you'd like to support it, pick whichever way suits you ([Fairy](https://fairy.hada.io/@filee) takes Korean cards and easy-pay). **Your name or logo here.** Monthly backers are listed here by name, and sponsors get their logo here and on Filee's About page. One-time supporters can ask to be listed too.
